template.name: template_bom_info_item

textComponent.name: Text
textComponent.event: component("multiline"):SetInt(0) component("font"):Set(game.getTextFont()) component("size"):SetFloat(0.3 * $scale * game.menuScaleX()) component("alignment"):SetInt(MenuTextComponent_TEXT_HCENTER_ALIGNED) component("text"):SetString("28/18") component:setColor($textR, $textG, $textB) component("autoScaleFactor"):SetFloat(0.01) component("autoScale"):SetInt(1) component("layer"):SetString("$layer")

touchComponent.name: Touch
touchComponent.event:
if not element.tooltip then element.tooltip = menu:addTemplateElement("template_tooltip", "tooltip_" .. element:name(), element) element.tooltip:relativeTo(element) element.tooltip:setOrientation(lua_sys.MenuOrientation(0, 0, -1, lua_sys.HCENTER, lua_sys.BOTTOM)) element.tooltip:setRelativeObjectAnchors(lua_sys.HCENTER, lua_sys.TOP) element.tooltip:init() element.tooltip:setPositionBroadcast(true) -- the required magic? element.tooltip.Text:GetVar("text"):SetString(element:templateVars().tooltipText) -- use variable version as we set it in BookOfMonsters.lua element.tooltip.Sprite:setSize(lua_sys.Vector2(element.tooltip.Text:absW() + 8 * $scale * game.menuScaleX(), element.tooltip.Text:absH() + 8 * $scale * game.menuScaleX()))
element.tooltip.onDoneHide = function() element:RemoveElement(element.tooltip) element.tooltip = nil end element.tooltip:Show() end

template.event: local textWidth = element:GetComponent("Text"):absW() local totalWidth = textWidth + element:GetComponent("Sprite"):absW() element:setSize(lua_sys.Vector2(totalWidth, $height))
element.isVisible = true element["Text"]("visible"):SetInt(1) element["Sprite"]("visible"):SetInt(1) element["Touch"]("enabled"):SetInt(1) element:Refresh()
